items.text: Every staged scrum board file has valid frontmatter.
The shipped default and this project's checklist registry both pass the validator.
lib/skill-allow-list.json has no unstaged modifications, so a test run or postinstall has not silently rewritten the security-relevant allow-list.

No Jenga content is added under docs/. docs/ belongs to the project and Jenga never puts Jenga content in it; Jenga's internal documents belong under project/documentation/ and the published site source under site/.

I understand that skills, agents, hooks and scripts are created and edited in the root directories, and that .claude/ and .agents/ are generated outputs that are never the primary location for a change.
Deterministic, repeatable steps in this change are implemented as scripts rather than as inline instructions in a SKILL.md.
The working tree is clean, so what is released is exactly what is committed.
The project's test suite has been run and passes on the exact commit being released.
This release is being published from the public repository, not from this private one; this repository's role is to mirror to it.
If a new top-level directory or config file was added, .publicignore has been reviewed so nothing private is reachable through the paths the public mirror publishes.

A pre-dispatch check-in has been run in this session and its findings surfaced, so no in-flight agent is wedged or orphaned before more work is dispatched. This item must never be set to block enforcement: satisfying it requires running a check-in, which is itself a tool call, so block would refuse the very dispatch that would satisfy it.
The dependency audit (scripts/audit-deps.sh) was run for this release and found nothing at or above the severity threshold, or the user chose to proceed without it.
items.verify: [ -f package.json ] || exit 0; S="$([ -f scripts/audit-deps.sh ] && echo scripts/audit-deps.sh || echo node_modules/@jenga-ai/agent/scripts/audit-deps.sh)"; bash "$S" --dir . --json; rc=$?; case "$rc" in 0) exit 0;; 4) echo "audit not run: no consent (audit-config.json mode is off or ask)" >&2; exit 4;; 1) echo "audit found vulnerabilities at or above the severity threshold" >&2; exit 1;; *) echo "audit could not complete (exit $rc)" >&2; exit "$rc";; esac
